# Findings — the beacon (`site/`)

## 1. What it is

A **static, read-only "estuary shore" site** generated by `site/build.py` into `site/dist/`, deployed as Cloudflare Worker assets (`site/wrangler.jsonc` → `assets.directory: ./dist`, name `nacho-business`).

- **Sources:** 15 markdown/HTML pages from `watch/onboard/*` plus `docs/ref/STACK_V1.md`, `watch/THE_STONE_THESIS_20260911.md`, `LETTER_ADAM_CRIGLER.md`, `dashboard/static/maze.html`, `watch/inbox/MATTHEWS_LENS.md` (`site/build.py:12-29`), plus 22 games copied from `dashboard/static/games/` (`site/build.py:30-33,458-463`).
- **The beacon = `site/dist/work.html`**, built by `work_page()` (`site/build.py:297-320`) wrapping the rooms HTML from `watch/onboard/WORK_WITH_ME.md` around a fixed hero (`site/build.py:396-419`).
- **6 rooms** (`site/build.py:235-236`): `#top` THE BEACON → `#play` PLAY THE PROOF (live iframe of `games/shadowbonk.html`) → `#receipts` THE LEDGER (claim/receipt table) → `#fresh` FRESH RECEIPTS (dated week log) → `#craft` THE CRAFT (toolbelt pills) → `#gate` THE GATE (email + X DM CTAs).
- **"Walk" mechanics:** full-viewport scroll-snap rooms (`.room{min-height:100vh;scroll-snap-align:start}`), arrow/PageDown/`j`/`k` room-jumping with a 1100ms lock, a fixed HUD (`ROOM x/6`), a right-side minimap with clickable nodes, and a WebGL fbm background shader with `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback (`WALKER_JS` `site/build.py:198-233`, `SHADER_JS` `site/build.py:241-295`).
- **The onboard kit** (`watch/onboard/`): 11 files (WELCOME, ORIENT, STORY, GAMEBOOK, GLOSSARY, GUEST_PROTOCOL, FAQ, FIRST_WEEK, TEAM, WORK_WITH_ME, README) — a guest-onboarding narrative ("guest weaver," stone protocol, tri-state claims) that `build.py` publishes as `/onboard/*`. `STORY.md` becomes the site lobby `site/dist/index.html` ("The Field and the Stones" parable + a single "work with me" link).

## 2. What works

| Strength | Where |
|---|---|
| Distinctive, memorable form — the page really is walkable; keyboard + minimap + HUD all function in the built output | `site/dist/work.html:71-93,206-241` |
| Proof-of-work as the product: a playable game embedded live on-domain, not a screenshot | `site/dist/work.html:94-107` (iframe `games/shadowbonk.html`) |
| Concrete numbers, not adjectives — 8-row claim/receipt ledger (8,819 knots, 744 GB DR, 0/275 fabrications, 48/48 lanes, 95.7% cache-hit) | `site/dist/work.html:109-126` |
| Freshness signal — dated "this week" room, `updated 2026-09-22` | `site/dist/work.html:128-141` |
| Availability is stated immediately: "available for remote work · now" + mailto above the fold | `site/dist/work.html:73,79-83` |
| Accessibility niceties: reduced-motion guards for shader + hint pulse | `site/build.py:102,244,292` |
| Honest framing of method over finishes ("shows the verification system that produced them") | `site/dist/work.html:143-151` |
| Build is simple and reproducible: one Python script, no JS framework, games shipped as single HTML files | `site/build.py`, `watch/onboard/TEAM.md:50-53` |

## 3. What is weak

**Trust-breaking bugs (fatal for a "every claim has a receipt" site):**
1. **Literal `{date}` in the lobby footer** — `FOOT` is an unformatted f-string fragment (`site/build.py:67-69`); `page()` never substitutes it. Visible in `site/dist/index.html:51`: `estuary shore v0 · {date}`.
2. **No 404 page** despite `"not_found_handling": "404-page"` in `site/wrangler.jsonc:7` — no `404.html` exists in `site/dist/`.
3. **No `/games` index** — GAMEBOOK says "The shelf is at **/games**" (`watch/onboard/GAMEBOOK.md:17`) and nav links `/games/swarm.html` (`site/build.py:62`), but no `site/dist/games/index.html` exists; the advertised shelf URL 404s or falls to a directory listing.
4. **Placeholder text published**: GLOSSARY has ~12 entries reading "The operator will fill this in" (`watch/onboard/GLOSSARY.md:7,15,19,...`); FIRST_WEEK still carries scaffolding headers `## CONTEXT` / `## TASK` above `# FIRST_WEEK.md` (`watch/onboard/FIRST_WEEK.md:1-9`

## Gopher findings: `memory/runs/ghost/` + `mag/ghost.py`

### What the autonomous layer actually did

**Design (`mag/ghost.py:1-22`)** — Ghost is a steer-experiment runner with a 5-stage loop: SENSE (system state incl. frustrations) → DEPLOY (inject test vector via `operator_inbox` seam) → MEASURE → CATALOG to `memory/runs/ghost/results.jsonl` → COMPOUND strong vectors. Paths wired at `mag/ghost.py:41-49` (`GHOST_DIR`, `test_vectors.jsonl`, `results.jsonl`, `trail.jsonl`, copilot inbox). Also has a Docker-only host gate (`_host_runtime_blocked`, `mag/ghost.py:52-63`).

**Actual output is diagnosis, not fixes:**
- **`memory/runs/ghost/autonomous_fixes/`** — 23 markdown FKB diagnoses, Aug 8 → Sep 22. Nearly all are `$0 read-only diagnosis` writes: root-cause + "Recommended fix" prose. Files include `run_python_2e689948ccfa.md`, `run_shell_c73866f2f1b5.md`, `run_shell_e566037def80.md`, `run_shell_3829e7639e3c.md`, `run_shell_0423ec4b2505.md`, `write_file_f86c1f906b03.md`, `write_file_9e0b1bd292e0.md`, `guard_registry_8ebc2e7c6cb1.md`, `loop_breaker_a3bb873230e0.md`, `source_trace_e23bf7d75ffa.md`, `spider_blind.md`, `list_dir_c4e93b935caa.md`, `refine_loop_grok_402_drainer_idle.md`, plus the three `operator_*` frustration-loop diagnoses.
- **`memory/runs/ghost/autonomous_trail.jsonl`** — 2,206 rows, 45 active days (2026-08-08 → 2026-09-22), 73 unique sigs, outcomes: **2,042 `spawned`, 164 `spawn_failed`** (spawn_failed clustered 2026-08-15→08-24; the 164 failures hit the same top sigs — `run_shell:c73866f2f1b5` 57×, `guard_registry:8ebc2e7c6cb1` 33×). Rows are spawn receipts only (`sig/quest_id/task_id/outcome`) — no completion/verification field, so the trail never records whether a fix landed.
- **Real code-adjacent findings it produced:** the error-loss/"backend reported failure" masking chain (`agent_cli.py` never surfaces `tools/shell.py`/`code_execution.py` stderr), the platform-mismatch `powershell`-on-Linux allowlist bug (`config.SHELL_ALLOW`), the false-success collapse guard, the DeepSeek quota spawn-failure cluster, the ghost_cycle 9-process respawn storm, and the `spawn_sites_no_window` guard regression (22 uncovered sites).

### What it keeps tripping on (per-signature respawn counts from `autonomous_trail.jsonl`)

| sig | spawns | span |
|---|---|---|
| `fkb:run_python:2e689948ccfa` | **504** | 08-08 → **09-22 (still spawning today)** |
| `fkb:run_shell:c73866f2f1b5` | 379 | 08-08 → 09-16 |
| `fkb:run_shell:3829e7639e3c` | 199 | 09-11 → 09-19 |
| `fkb:guard_registry:8ebc2e7c6cb1` | 185 | 08-11 → 08-31 |
| `fkb:write_file:f86c1f906b03` | 102 | 08-08 → 09-13 |

- **Diagnosis without remediation.** The fixes are repeatedly *diagnosed and filed, never applied.* `run_python_2e689948ccfa.md` says: 12,265 FKB rows, "STILL LIVE, +1,116 rows since the 2026-09-14 pass", "the fix is still NOT applied". `run_shell_c73866f2f1b5.md`: 25,038 rows, "STILL LIVE". `operator_steer_override_loop.md`: "Fix status: NOT YET APPLIED". `write_file_9e0b1bd292e0.md`: remedy "exists but never wired into preflight path". 8 fix files contain STILL-LIVE / NOT-APPLIED language.
- **Re-diagnosing the same sig 500×** — the autonomous layer re-spawns a fresh diagnosis quest for a sig it already wrote a file for (one fix file, 504 spawn receipts for `run_python:2e689948ccfa`), because the trail tracks spawn, not closure.
- **Top sigs with no fix file at all** despite dozens of spawns: `run_shell:f710fac86427` (43), `source_trace:64e24bd13bc5` (29), `list_dir:ce80dd8406b5` (28), `lane_scheduler_sv.log:eff6c76c2132` (30), `lane_scheduler.log:968797f5a97f` (28), `source_trace:8bfa1cb2caa8` (25), `search_files:44027daf149c` (26), `_:d2b80153f96b` (21).
- **Its own infrastructure tripping:** 164 `spawn_failed` rows (Aug 15–24); the ghost_cycle singleton spawned as 9 duplicate `while True: cycle()` processes (`loop_breaker_a3bb873230e0.md`, 227 events; `source_trace_e23bf7d75ffa.md`, 185 events — same pid set); `spider_blind.md` — spider reporting 0 signal

## Addendum — final two checks (read-only)

### Root formula confirmed
From `mag/verkle_knot.py:142-158`:
- **Leaf hash:** `sha256(b"leaf:" + json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True))` (`:144`)
- **Node hash:** `sha256(b"node:" + left + b":" + right)` with odd nodes duplicated (`:156`)
- **`verkle_root`** = Merkle root over all leaf hashes; **`parent_verkle_root`** = root of the prefix (`:709-713`); genesis parent = `sha256(b"empty")` (`:418`)
- Earlier naive concatenation guesses failed because of the `leaf:`/`node:` domain tags — now verified end-to-end:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Recomputed root over all 9,809 leaves | `5ac425dcd6195330…` |
| Tip root / last-row root | identical — **full rehash MATCH** |
| Genesis parent of row 0 | `sha256(b"empty")` — **MATCH** |

The chain is not just link-continuous; the tip root is **independently reproducible** from the leaf hashes alone.
